Q: Finding way around chromium's source code A:

Use the awesome 'Chromium Code Search' at https://source.chromium.org (formerly at cs.chromium.org and before that code.google.com/p/chromium/codesearch).

It has symbol lookup, git integration and ontop of that nice docs for everything and is also available for many others of Google's open source projects at https://cs.opensource.google

It goes back to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_Code_Search which lived at www.google.com/codesearch

Sourcegraph is also good, even better for loosley connected words like unsafe origin secure in https://sourcegraph.com/search?q=repo:%5Egithub%5C.com/chromium/chromium%24+unsafe+origin+secure&patternType=regexp&case=yes&sm=0

Grep.app in general is also good, but not for Chromium for some reason. Probably because the repo is too big, but then still https://grep.app/torvalds/linux?q=ebpf works.
